roster_updates.name: Stephen
roster_updates.who: Bram's estranged husband, Hollis's father, lives across the park

scenes.summary: Arguing over shares, Rufus revealed it is his own family he is robbing — the safe was his grandfather's — and insisted they need Lena to open it as Milo threatened him.

beats.text: Rufus is the late owner's grandson, stealing from his own family's estate
Milo threatens Lena; Rufus says they cannot open the safe without Lena

humor.joke: Rufus mocks Milo's gangster talk: 'You're a bus driver... you live in Flatbush'

scenes.summary: While the burglars were distracted, Bram dashed out of the panic room to her bedroom and grabbed her cell phone, making it back just in time — but there was no signal inside the room.

beats.text: Bram risks a dash out of the room to grab her cell phone and makes it back
The cell phone gets no signal inside the steel room

moments.what: 'If I can't get back, close the door' — the dash

scenes.summary: Bram remembered the house's main phone line ran by the room and spliced into its wires; meanwhile the burglars realized Rufus never cut the main line. She reached 911 but was put on hold and lost the line.

beats.text: Bram splices into the main phone line and reaches 911, but is put on hold and cut off

scenes.summary: They called Hollis's father, but the line was garbled; Bram insisted he would come because they still are a family. Hollis confessed she had been hiding that she was dizzy and thirsty.

beats.text: A garbled call reaches Hollis's father; Bram insists he will come to help
Hollis admits she is dizzy and thirsty — her blood sugar is crashing

scenes.summary: Bram realized Hollis, a diabetic, needed sugar or her Glucagon shot, which was in the fridge in Hollis's room outside. Meanwhile Rufus gave up and tried to quit with a payout, but Milo declared nobody leaves and he would open the safe.

beats.text: Hollis is diabetic; her emergency Glucagon injection is outside the room, in her bedroom fridge
Rufus tries to quit; Milo declares nobody leaves

humor.joke: 'I'm dizzy, not deaf.' 'Still a smart ass, excellent sign.'

moments.what: mother and daughter calm each other about the attack

scenes.summary: When Rufus tried to walk out, Milo violently stopped him, apparently shooting him, then held Lena at gunpoint and forced him to come up with a way into the room.

beats.text: Milo violently stops Rufus from leaving (apparently shooting him) and seizes control
At gunpoint, Lena is forced to find a way into the room

scenes.setting_guess: house, in view of the room's monitors
scenes.summary: Hollis's father arrived and was captured; the burglars beat him in front of the monitors to make Bram open the door. Hollis screamed for her daddy, Bram refused, Lena protested, and Hollis began to slip into a diabetic attack.

beats.text: The father arrives and is captured; the burglars beat him on camera to force the door open
Hollis goes into a diabetic attack and begs her mother for the injection

open_threads: Will Bram leave the room for the Glucagon?

story_so_far: Bram and her diabetic daughter Hollis are trapped in a panic room while three burglars hunt for fourteen million dollars in a safe inside it: Rufus (the dead owner's grandson), Lena (a panic-room builder) and volatile Milo. Gas, a cellphone dash and a spliced 911 call fail; a garbled call reaches the father. Hollis's blood sugar crashes and her Glucagon is outside the room. Milo violently takes control from Rufus and forces Lena to find a way in; the father arrives, is captured and beaten on camera to make Bram open the door, as Hollis slips into a diabetic attack.
